antarctic_gateway.policy_role: recognized strategic/gateway context in Chilean Antarctic policy and regional planning
antarctic_gateway.rule: Gateway policy language must never be converted into proof of current direct commercial Antarctic flights or fly-cruise products from Puerto Williams.

prohibited_inferences: Puerto Williams and Puerto Toro are the same settlement.
A ferry or cruise symbol on a tourism map proves a current timetable.
Puerto Navarino ramp proves a regular international passenger ferry.
A documented rescue proves helicopter availability or response time for future incidents.
Existing hospital infrastructure proves permanent specialist coverage.
Existing fuel infrastructure proves current stock.
5G or fiber infrastructure proves uninterrupted coverage at a specific location/time.
Gateway status proves direct current commercial Antarctic air service.
Villa Ukika is merely a tourist attraction or a frozen ethnographic site.
Tourism-map positions are canonical Atlas coordinates.
